limits: No vendor assembly execution or original GUI observation.

hN4K numeric orchestration is independently composed from retained instructions; primitives named in methodsReplayed execute retained instruction arrays. Default composition uses TN46 false, while RN4I true and its delta/cap behavior are separate comparison cases.
System arithmetic, point/rect storage, collections, rotation matrices, editor callbacks and method dispatch are explicit JavaScript sinks.
Contour construction/reindex filtering, full platform transform matrices, empty input and malformed nonfinite point lists are not replayed end-to-end.
Exit wrapper cases use Shape300 and explicit line-like/edited flag sinks; native special line reclassification and history manager internals are not executed.
